title: The Ferrari Strategy Decision Tree
quote: Plan A? No, Plan E. We are checking. Box box... stay out!
description: The quintessential @f1memesig post illustrating the infamous Ferrari Strategy Decision Tree. Whatever scenario happens on track, the answer is always 'We are checking' or pitting onto wet tyres on a dry track.
caption: Ferrari strategy meetings be like: 'Plan A through Z failed, let's execute Plan 🅱️' 💀😭 #f1memesig #ferrari #f1 #formula1 #leclerc

imageStyle.subtitle: SCENARIO: DRY TRACK ☀️ -> STRATEGY: FULL WETS 🌧️

title: El Plan — Trust The Process
quote: Trust El Plan. You have to believe.
description: Fernando Alonso looking directly into the camera with absolute certainty. @f1memesig turned 'El Plan' into a religion across F1 social media, proving Nando can meme any car onto the podium.
caption: 14 years waiting for 33rd win. El Plan never dies. 🔋🟢 #f1memesig #alonso #astonmartin #elplan #f1

title: Leave Me Alone, I Know What I'm Doing
quote: Leave me alone, I know what I'm doing.
description: Perhaps the most iconic F1 radio message of all time. Kimi was leading the race for Lotus when his race engineer kept trying to feed him information. The Iceman's blunt shutdown became a global meme and was printed on T-shirts worldwide.
caption: Me when someone tries to give me unsolicited advice at work 🧊👑 #f1memesig #kimiraikkonen #iceman #f1

title: Max Verstappen Pit Stop For Extra Point
quote: Can we pit for softs? I want the fastest lap point. GP: 'No Max' -> Pits anyway.
description: Max Verstappen leading by 30+ seconds asking to pit on lap 70/71 just because he was bored and wanted fastest lap. The ultimate dominance flex immortalized on @f1memesig.
caption: GP: 'Please just bring the car home' Max: 'Hold my Red Bull' 🔵💨 #f1memesig #maxverstappen #redbullracing #f1

imageStyle.subtitle: GAP TO P2: 28.4 SECONDS -> TIME TO PIT FOR FASTEST LAP ⏱️

title: Lando Norris: It Is What It Is
quote: It is what it is mate... we move.
description: Lando Norris' signature response whenever race strategy goes chaotic or he finishes P2 behind Max for the 10th time. The meme template loved by millions on @f1memesig.
caption: Lando after losing 3 places at start but finishing on podium anyway: 🤷‍♂️🧡 #f1memesig #landonorris #mclaren #f1

imageStyle.subtitle: STATE OF MIND: IT IS WHAT IT IS 🧘‍♂️

title: GP2 Engine! GP2! Aaargh!
quote: GP2 engine! GP2! Aaargh!
description: At Honda's home race in Suzuka, Alonso's frustration with the woefully underpowered McLaren-Honda engine boiled over. His furious scream comparing the power unit to a GP2 car became the definitive symbol of the McLaren-Honda disaster era.
caption: Alonso shouting GP2 ENGINE at Honda's home race remains the single coldest radio message ever 💀🔊 #f1memesig #alonso #mclaren #gp2

title: Bono, My Tyres Are Gone
quote: Bono, my tyres are gone.
description: Lewis Hamilton's classic complaint about tyre wear — usually followed by setting the fastest lap of the race. This radio message became the ultimate F1 meme because it happened SO consistently that fans could predict a Hamilton fastest lap the moment he said it.
caption: Translation: My tyres have 30 more laps in them and I'm about to break the track record 💜⚡ #f1memesig #lewishamilton #mercedesamgf1 #bono

imageStyle.subtitle: STATUS: TYRES DEAD 🛞 -> ACTION: SET LAP RECORD ⏱️

title: Valtteri Bottas Australian Mullet Era
quote: VB Longneck, tank top, speedos, mullet. Living his best life.
description: Valtteri Bottas throwing away all F1 PR filter, growing a legendary mullet, driving a ute, and riding bicycles in speedos. The single most unhinged and beloved character arc on @f1memesig.
caption: Mercedes Bottas vs Sauber Bottas is the greatest personality upgrade in sports history 🍺🇦🇺 #f1memesig #valtteribottas #mullet #f1

title: BWOAH
quote: Bwoah... it's more or less the same for everyone.
description: Kimi's legendary non-answer to literally every interview question. Whether asked about strategy, feelings, or his weekend plans, the answer always started with 'Bwoah'. Fans have catalogued over 59 different BWOAHs.
caption: Journalist: 'Kimi how was the car balance?' Kimi: 'Bwoah, car was okay.' Legendary 🧊 #f1memesig #bwoah #kimiraikkonen

title: Carlos Sainz: Smooth Operator
quote: Smooooooth Operatooooor... smooth operator!
description: Carlos Sainz singing Sade over team radio after taking pole or winning a race. The anthem of tactical genius and DRS train creation on @f1memesig.
caption: Giving DRS to Norris to block Mercedes from winning Singapore GP was 200 IQ Smooth Operator move 🧠🌶️ #f1memesig #carlossainz #singaporegp

title: I Am Stupid! I Am Stupid!
quote: I am stupid! I am stupid!
description: After crashing into the castle section barriers during qualifying in Baku, Leclerc's brutally honest self-assessment over team radio was both heartbreaking and hilarious. His raw self-deprecation endeared him to millions of fans.
caption: Me after committing to a terrible financial decision 💔🧱 #f1memesig #charlesleclerc #iamstupid #baku

imageStyle.subtitle: CASTLE SECTION vs F1 CAR 🧱 (CASTLE WINS)

title: Kimi Gets His Ice Cream
quote: Where's my ice cream? I was told there would be ice cream.
description: During a red flag stoppage in pouring rain, while other drivers paced nervously in the garage, Kimi was spotted casually wearing shorts and eating an ice cream. Peak Iceman behavior.
caption: Torrential rain red flag? Everyone stressing. Kimi: Magnum Almond 🍦🥶 #f1memesig #kimiraikkonen #icecream #legend

imageStyle.subtitle: WEATHER: MONSOON ⛈️ -> KIMI DIET: ICE CREAM 🍦

title: SUPER MAX — The Anthem
quote: Super Max, Max, Max, super super Max Max Max!
description: The fan-made Dutch anthem celebrating Max Verstappen went insanely viral, becoming the most iconic F1 fan song of all time. It's played at every Dutch GP and the entire Zandvoort grandstand sings it in unison.

title: Blue Flag! Blue Flag! HONESTLY!
quote: Blue flag! Blue flag! Honestly, what are we doing here?!
description: Seb's high-pitched, frantic screaming for backmarkers to get out of the way became his signature radio moment. The intensity of his pleas — often when he was comfortably in the lead — made it comedy gold.

title: Toto Wolff Table Smash
quote: NO! NO NO NO NO!
description: Toto Wolff's habit of violently smashing his headset or pounding the table after something goes wrong for Mercedes became one of the most GIF'd moments in F1. During the 2021 title fight, every Toto rage moment was pure entertainment.

title: The Shoey — Daniel Ricciardo's Signature
quote: GET IN THERE! SHOEY TIME!
description: Daniel Ricciardo started drinking champagne from his racing boot on the podium, and then made everyone else do it too — including Sir Patrick Stewart and Gerard Butler. The shoey became one of F1's most iconic celebration rituals.

title: Inspector Seb
quote: The stewards need to inspect THEMSELVES.
description: Vettel's habit of peering into rival cars earned him the 'Inspector Seb' nickname. After the controversial Canadian GP penalty, he swapped the 1st and 2nd place boards. The meme became his second personality.

title: Which One Is The OK Button?!
quote: Which one is the OK button?! ... I don't have an OK button!
description: A hilariously circular argument between Lance Stroll and his engineer about which button on the steering wheel was the 'OK' button. The increasingly confused exchange went viral as one of the most relatable tech support moments in F1.

title: Max vs GP — The Greatest Duo
quote: No, no, no! That was so not right!
description: Max Verstappen and his race engineer GP have the most entertaining working relationship on the grid. Their constant bickering, sarcastic banter, and Max's fiery complaints make every radio exchange pure gold.

title: F1 Out Of Context — The Ultimate Compilation
quote: Context? We don't do that here.
description: The 'F1 Out Of Context' meme genre takes perfectly normal F1 moments and strips them of all context, creating surreal, absurd, and absolutely hilarious content. From drivers' bizarre gestures to engineers' strange phrases, nothing is safe.
